scope: Read-only review with injected negative controls in disposable actual SQLite fixtures only.

findings.title: Missing phase acceptance gate
findings.evidence: Forcing only retained_success admission to deny still produced COMPLETED/GREEN. Invariant-only checks do not establish the named lifecycle behavior.
findings.required_change: Gate declared expected phase success/denial and observed withdrawal/requalification states in the runner, retaining the failing row and stopping subsequent phases.

findings.title: Support preparation writes are outside the grading window
findings.evidence: A Runtime.shadow wrapper performed an actual unauthorized write to the unrelated sentinel. Every sequence phase and the whole report remained GREEN with no integrity errors.
findings.required_change: Read registry/counter before preparation, compare after preparation, and forbid any preparation mutation before querying. Preserve prior-query continuity. Apply the same boundary to independent pilot preparation.

findings.title: Qualification disposition is fabricated for the withdrawn phase
findings.evidence: After leaving actual persisted qualification ELIGIBLE while retaining the revoked authority, withdrawn_query reported qualification_disposition=INELIGIBLE even though prepared_qualification.disposition=ELIGIBLE, and the report remained GREEN.
findings.required_change: Read the actual disposition and compare against the declared expected transition; do not insert expected labels as observed results.

findings.title: Retained failure deletion is not detected
findings.evidence: Deleting the actual SQLite FAIL observation during recovery support preserved all expected task/denial outcomes and COMPLETED/GREEN; recovery observations contained no FAIL despite the explicit retention claim.
findings.required_change: Require every previously retained observation identity and canonical content to remain through preparation and query boundaries; detect removal or alteration before continuing.

independent_checks.retention_probe_setup_error: The first retention probe used an incorrect SQLite column and aborted due to test setup. The corrected probe/result above demonstrates the finding; the setup-error result is retained in the private work folder.

limits: Both arms intentionally share identical deterministic retained-state policy; this is not learned adaptation.
Development fixture, shared ancestry, generated support and controlled clock; no held-out, business, canonical-service or production claim.
Sealing currently records ordering in the same trusted process, not a security boundary.
